attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: multi-step-content-publishing-with-approval

steps:
  - id: fetch_content_draft
    op: data/fetch
    params:
      source: content_drafts
      key: "{{ trigger.draft_id }}"
    output: draft

  - id: validate_draft
    op: validation/schema
    params:
      input: "{{ draft }}"
      schema: editorial_schema
    output: validated_draft

  - id: apply_approval_rule
    op: rule/evaluate
    params:
      rule: editorial_approval
      input: "{{ validated_draft }}"
    output: approval_result

  - id: route_decision
    op: control/branch
    params:
      condition: "{{ approval_result.approved == true }}"
      on_true: publish_subworkflow
      on_false: send_to_revision_queue

  - id: send_to_revision_queue
    op: queue/enqueue
    params:
      queue: revision_queue
      payload:
        draft_id: "{{ trigger.draft_id }}"
        draft: "{{ validated_draft }}"
        rejection_reasons: "{{ approval_result.reasons }}"
    output: revision_result

  - id: publish_subworkflow
    op: subworkflow/invoke
    params:
      workflow_id: publishing_subworkflow
      input:
        draft_id: "{{ trigger.draft_id }}"
        content: "{{ validated_draft }}"
      precondition: "{{ approval_result.approved == true }}"
    output: publish_result

  - id: log_publishing_decision
    op: logging/record
    params:
      event: publishing_decision
      details:
        draft_id: "{{ trigger.draft_id }}"
        approved: "{{ approval_result.approved }}"
        approval_reasons: "{{ approval_result.reasons }}"
        publish_outcome: "{{ publish_result | default(none) }}"
        revision_outcome: "{{ revision_result | default(none) }}"
        timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
